start: Owner signed in, gym online on a gym server that keeps video links; plan builder open with one exercise

steps.action: Tap '+ Add your video' on the exercise
user_sees: Box 'Your video of it (YouTube link, optional)' with 'https://youtu.be/…' and 'Members see “Watch your trainer” on this exercise in their app.'
must_not: The box shown when the gym server cannot keep the link

steps.action: Paste a YouTube link, tap 'Save plan'
user_sees: No red words under the box
The plan's toast, for example '“<name>” saved and sent.'
must_not: The link saved on a different exercise
The link changed so that it opens another video

start: Owner signed in, in the 'Workout of the day' sheet with one exercise

steps.action: Tap '+ Add your video', paste a YouTube link, tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: The same box and hint as in a plan
Toast 'Saved. Members see it now.'
must_not: The link dropped from the saved workout

start: Owner signed in, in the plan builder

steps.action: Paste a link that is not YouTube into the video box
user_sees: Red words 'Paste a YouTube link (youtube.com or youtu.be).'
must_not: Any other site's link accepted

steps.action: Tap 'Save plan' with that link still there
user_sees: '<exercise>: the video link must be a YouTube link (youtube.com or youtu.be).'
The sheet stays open
must_not: The plan saved with the bad link
The plan saved with the link silently removed

steps.action: Open the builder in a gym that is not online or on an older gym server
user_sees: No '+ Add your video' button on exercises
must_not: A link typed that can never reach a member

start: Owner signed in, a plan saved with a video link on one exercise

steps.action: Open the plan with 'Edit'
user_sees: The video box already open with the saved link
must_not: The link hidden behind '+ Add your video'
The link hidden because the server check has not answered yet (a saved link always shows)

steps.action: Clear the box and tap 'Save changes'
user_sees: Toast '“<name>” updated.'
must_not: The old link still shown to members (unknown how an empty box is saved: not read)

steps.action: Use 'Copy day' on that day
user_sees: The copied exercise keeps the link (unknown: not read)
must_not: A half-copied link

start: Owner signed in, adding a video

steps.action: Paste a link to a video and save
user_sees: Members who get this plan see “Watch your trainer” on that exercise
must_not: The video uploaded to or stored by MettleUp (only the link is kept)
Members who do not get the plan seeing the link
A link to a private page that asks members to sign in elsewhere
